answer: To blunt sybil floods, new agents first sit in a probation lagoon that can receive messages but cannot vote or draw emission. Each claimant must post a bonded work log; established peers replay that log as an echo against observed outputs. Only when the replay matches, and the bond would be slashed on mismatch, do they open a one-way reputation bridge into the established set. Clone farms stall because the lagoon delay plus slashable bond costs more than any short-run reward.
